restore.regular_files: Use scripts/backup/release_bundle.py restore with the SHA-256 manifest at the checkout root; it verifies all members and refuses conflicting files.
restore.symlinks: After selected target bytes and any named prior-release dependency are restored, recreate only listed internal links using relative paths. Do not recreate external-target links automatically. See restore_symlinks.py --help.
restore.absolute_paths_in_decks: Original saved decks and metadata remain byte-identical and may contain their original absolute workspace path. Reproduction entrypoints must regenerate decks for the new root; do not rewrite archived evidence in place.
restore.full_PDK: Install the matching public PDK/rule decks/tools from the committed lock files separately; saved ngspice model files are only frozen subsets.

retention: No active raw input, waveform, failure log, PDK or working tree is removed. Only separately authorized staging/download duplicates may be cleaned after remote readback and restoration proof.

archive_policy.readback: Sequential streaming SHA-256; no full downloaded copy on disk.
